name: ml-time-series
description: Use when the user asks to forecast weekly demand for the next quarter, time series forecasting, ARIMA/SARIMA, Prophet, ETS, statsforecast, LightGBM lag models, TFT, seasonality or backtesting with temporal cross-validation. Produces model choice, backtest design and MASE/sMAPE evaluation. Not for anomaly alerts (use ml-anomaly-detection).
